summary.text: Laura Jane Cohen is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 15th District, which covers part of Fairfax County, and has served since January 10, 2024.
Cohen sits on the House committees on Counties, Cities and Towns; Health and Human Services; and Labor and Commerce.

paragraphs.text: Laura Jane Cohen was born in Atlanta, Georgia, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Cohen's education as University of Georgia (B.A. Political Science, 1997).
The profile gives Cohen's occupation as school board member.
Cohen's listed memberships and affiliations include Moms Demand Action, Parent Teacher Association, Food for Neighbors.
